videos.title: Why Your Cardiologist Might Tell You To Skip AirPods
videos.description:
Next time you visit a friend or loved one with a heart condition, you might want to put your AirPods away. A 2022 study found that the magnetic fields produced by headphones, smartphones, and other electronic devices are strong enough to disrupt defibrillators, pacemakers, and other cardiovascular implantable devices.
